_note: Required application documents the bot can auto-attach. Each entry: file (relative to the project root), doc_type (Handshake documentTypeId name), section_regex (modal header that signals the requirement), picker_query (text typed into the react-select to find the doc), instruction_keywords (substrings matched against the employer's free-text note in a generic 'Attach other required documents' section — typo-tolerant; falls back to a stem of the doc name), auto_attach (attach without asking). Add entries here as new required uploads appear — no code change needed.
